tools.name: zalgo_text
tools.description: Turn text into creepy zalgo / glitch text with combining marks above, through and below each letter. Use `intensity` (light, medium, heavy) or exact 0-100 `above`/`mid`/`below`. Same `seed` gives the same output. Returns a renderability estimate: heavy text may get trimmed on some apps.

tools.name: fancy_text
tools.description: Convert text to Unicode "fonts" (bold, italic, cursive, gothic, bubble, small caps, wide, strikethrough and more). Pass `style` for one, or omit it for all 17.
